name: project_overview
description: The whole picture, as JSON: file tree with flags, folders and who may see them, roles, members, the console's state, packages, tournaments, the board, the file open on the teacher's screen. Call it first.

name: read_file
description: A file's content. Text comes back as text (Markdown too); an image as an image; another binary file as a base64 blob.

path.description: Path from the project root, with /.

name: write_file
description: Replaces a text file's whole content, creating the file if needed. Everyone sees it live; only what differs is changed.

path.description: Path from the project root, with /.

name: edit_file
description: Replaces an exact piece of a text file. `old` must occur once, unless `all` is true.

path.description: Path from the project root, with /.

name: create_file
description: Creates a text file, failing if the path is taken. `*.test.py` files are hidden from students unless `hidden` is false.

path.description: Path from the project root, with /.

name: upload_file
description: Adds a file from base64 bytes (a picture, a PDF, data). If the path is taken, the file gets a free name; the answer says which.

path.description: Path from the project root, with /.

name: create_folder
description: Creates a folder (parents included).

path.description: Path from the project root, with /.

name: delete_path
description: Deletes a file, or a folder with everything inside. No undo.

path.description: Path from the project root, with /.

name: move_path
description: Moves or renames a file or folder to the full new path. Folder access moves with it, and open editors stay bound.

from.description: Path from the project root, with /.

to.description: Path from the project root, with /.

name: duplicate_path
description: Copies a file or folder next to itself (or to `to`), with flags and folder access.

path.description: Path from the project root, with /.

to.description: Optional full path for the copy.

name: search_files
description: Finds lines in the project's text files. Returns path, line number and text, at most 200 matches.

regex.description: Treat query as a regular expression.

name: set_file_flags
description: Sets a file's flags: `hidden` (admins alone see it), `protected` (admins alone edit it).

path.description: Path from the project root, with /.

name: set_folder_access
description: Says who may see inside a folder: "public", "admins" (admins alone), or a custom role's name.

path.description: Path from the project root, with /.

name: open_file
description: Opens a file on the teacher's screen.

path.description: Path from the project root, with /.

name: get_diagnostics
description: Errors in a file: Ruff for Python, clang for C++ (loads the compiler the first time).

path.description: Path from the project root, with /.

name: format_file
description: Formats a file: Ruff for Python, Prettier for HTML, CSS, JavaScript and Markdown, and JSON. Writes the result.

path.description: Path from the project root, with /.

name: get_flowchart
description: A Python or C++ file's flowchart as nodes and edges (what students see under Show tree).

path.description: Path from the project root, with /.

name: get_syntax_tree
description: A Python or C++ file's syntax tree.

path.description: Path from the project root, with /.

name: run_program
description: Runs a file in the shared console (stopping a run in progress) and returns the console when the program ends, asks for input, stops in the debugger, or `wait_seconds` pass (default 30, at most 120; it keeps running after that). With `debug` (Python only) it stops at `breakpoints`, or on the first line without any.

path.description: Path from the project root, with /.

name: console_read
description: The console: status, exit, debugger state, output (last `tail` characters, default 20000). Can wait for the program to end, ask for input or stop.

name: send_input
description: Answers the program's request for input with one line, then returns the console as run_program does.

name: send_eof
description: Sends end of input (Ctrl+D), then returns the console.

name: stop_program
description: Stops the running program and returns the console.

name: clear_console
description: Clears the shared console.

name: debug_command
description: While stopped in the debugger: continue, next (step over), step (into), return (out) or stop. Returns the console with the new stop's line, variables and call stack.

name: run_check
description: Runs the tests of a solution file (its nearest name.test.py) in a fresh interpreter and returns each test's result. Takes up to 30 s, a tournament's up to 2 min. An admin's own check in a session goes to no table.

path.description: Path from the project root, with /.

name: list_members
description: Who is connected: peer number, name, level, roles, owner, the file they are in.

name: set_member_role
description: Changes a connected member's level and custom roles. An admin cannot touch other admins or make admins; the owner can.

name: kick_member
description: Removes a member from the session (every tab of theirs). They can come back by the link.

name: ban_member
description: Removes a member and refuses them for the rest of the session. There is no unban.

name: share_links
description: Every role's join link and code, and this MCP link.

name: add_role
description: Creates a custom role, with what it may do with public files, and its join link.

name: set_frozen
description: Freezes the project for students (read-only, a frost over the page) or thaws it.

name: presentation_start
description: Presents a PDF or PPTX to everyone, at a page (from 1).

path.description: Path from the project root, with /.

name: presentation_page
description: Turns the presentation to a page.

name: presentation_stop
description: Ends the presentation.

name: list_packages
description: The project's Python packages and C++ libraries, with versions and status.

name: install_package
description: Installs a package for everyone: Python by name (`requests`, `numpy==2.0`), C++ header-only from GitHub (`nlohmann/json`, `fmtlib/fmt@11.0.2`). Waits for the result.

name: remove_package
description: Removes a package: Python by name, C++ by owner/repo.

name: tournament_list
description: The project's tournaments and whether each table is private.

name: tournament_standings
description: One tournament's table: place, name, scores by task, total.

name: tournament_set_private
description: Hides a tournament's table from students or shows it.

name: board_read
description: The whiteboard's elements: id, type, position, size, text, colours, bindings. Use `board_image` to see it.

name: board_add
description: Adds elements to the whiteboard (Excalidraw's skeleton format). Each has `type` (rectangle, ellipse, diamond, text, arrow, line), `x`, `y`; shapes take `width`, `height`, `backgroundColor`, `strokeColor`, `label: {text}`; text takes `text`, `fontSize`; arrows take `width`, `height`, `label`, and `start`/`end`: `{id}` of an element to connect, given in this same call or earlier. Pass your own `id` to refer to one later.

name: board_update
description: Changes properties of whiteboard elements. Each item has `id` and the properties to set (x, y, width, height, strokeColor, backgroundColor, text, angle, opacity…).

name: board_delete
description: Deletes whiteboard elements by id, with the labels bound to them.

name: board_clear
description: Deletes everything on the whiteboard.

name: board_mermaid
description: Draws a Mermaid diagram on the whiteboard as editable elements, placed at (`x`, `y`) if given.

name: board_image
description: The whiteboard as a PNG, so you can see the result. Everything, or only `ids`.

name: board_duplicate
description: Copies whiteboard elements with their labels, moved by (`dx`, `dy`, default 20).

name: board_align
description: Lines whiteboard elements up with the outermost of them.

name: board_distribute
description: Equal gaps between at least three whiteboard elements.

name: board_group
description: Groups whiteboard elements.

name: board_ungroup
description: Takes whiteboard elements out of their outermost group.

name: board_lock
description: Locks whiteboard elements against changes on the canvas, or unlocks them (`locked`: false).

name: board_export
description: The whiteboard as the JSON of a .excalidraw file.

name: board_import
description: Puts a .excalidraw file's JSON on the whiteboard; `replace` clears it first.

name: board_snapshot
description: Saves the whiteboard under a name, in the teacher's tab, until it closes.

name: board_restore
description: Puts a saved snapshot back, replacing what is on the whiteboard.

name: export_project
description: The whole project as a .zip, in base64: files, folders and access rules.

name: import_project
description: Replaces the whole project with a .zip in base64 (as made by export_project). Everything now in it is lost.

name: reset_project
description: Deletes every file. With `language` (python or cpp) it starts again from that language's starter file; without it the owner is asked. Owner only. No undo.
